context: Mei and Aoi chat about a recipe over coffee.
purpose: Casual register; adverbs (ちなみに/既に/といった/おそらく/あまりに) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: このケーキ、あまりに甘くて驚いたの。
lines.en: This cake was so sweet it surprised me.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle amused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ちなみに、砂糖を多めに入れたんだ。
lines.en: By the way, I added extra sugar.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm sheepish delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もう、味は既に決まってたの?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、おそらく次はもっと控えるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, next time I'll probably hold back.
lines.style: thoughtful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: チョコといった、別の味も試したいな。
lines.en: I'd like to try other flavors like chocolate.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 既に、レシピは考えてあるよ。
lines.en: I've already thought up the recipe.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ちなみに、ナッツといった具も合うよね。
lines.en: By the way, toppings like nuts go well too.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おそらく、それが一番人気になるよ!
lines.en: That'll probably be the most popular!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
